caveat: This is a legging-drift estimate: how much the basis moves between decision and both legs' actual fills, using this project's own measured send-to-fill latency (n=20, bootstrap-resampled). It does NOT measure broker fill quality, requotes, rejections, or price improvement/adverse selection at the moment of fill -- R-007 already flags why a simulated environment cannot substitute for that. Latency is dated to 2026-09-17/18 Stage 2 conditions; the account owner has an open request with the broker to reduce futures feed latency, which would make this stale once it takes effect.
